# Paper Tear

**Distortion › Break** · v1.0.0 · 36 frames at 30 fps (18–72)

The old scene rips down the middle along a ragged edge, and the two pieces pull apart to show the new scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/paper-tear@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Collage and scrapbook styles
- Editorial and punk looks
- Before/after reveals

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import paperTear from './transitions/06-distortion/break/paper-tear';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(paperTear, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 36 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `paper` | color | `"#F7F5F0"` |  | Colour of the torn paper edge. |
| `roughness` | number | `0.06` | 0–0.15 | How jagged the tear is. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
